svg.text: verified in OpenSCAD across the throw / index / catch
one springy part (blade + hook + button); the throw is derived from the engagement so pressing always clears it
a leaf-spring nub clicks into one dimple per chamber — every chamber self-locates at the drop station
concave landing, springy fingers, settles by a tall lip
drop path: chamber → open flap → caught by lip
All geometry compiles; latch/detent/cushion are print-in-place springs (tune blade thickness & clearances to your printer).
States are parametric: latch_state, flap_state, detent_on, cushion_on — see README-dropper.md.
